00049 extern "C" void JNICALL Java_uk_co_miajo_UGen_UGenAudio_createIOHost(JNIEnv *env, jobject thiz, jdouble sr, jint numInputs, jint numOutputs, jint blockSize)
00050 {
00051   __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_DEBUG, "ugen", "createIOHost %f %d %d %d", sr, numInputs, numOutputs, blockSize);
00052   
00053   if(host == 0)

00055     host = createHost(sr, numInputs, numOutputs, blockSize);
00056         
00057     host->init();
00058

00061   }
00062   else
00063   {
00064     __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_DEBUG, "ugen", "createIOHost failed, AndroidIOHost already created");
00065   }
